'''The Accidental Treasure''' (Japanese: '''偶然のたからもの''' ''A Chance Treasure'') is the fifty-third chapter of the [[Magical Pokémon Journey]] manga.

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}
[[Hazel]] finds an old photo album with pictures of herself and [[Almond]] as kids, and she remembers their childhood. She asks {{MPJ|Pikachu}} and {{MPJ|Clefairy}} how they met.
